item.title: Week 7: Generative AI - RAG
item.description: Computer, how does the stratigraphy of building A relate to that of building B? The ability to ask questions of our data using our everyday language is the StarTrek dream, isn’t it. ‘Computer, when and how was this site abandoned?’ ‘Computer, identify the logical inconsistencies in this stratigraphy’. ‘Computer, what is the relationship between phase 4 and the area B group?’ Things like that. Generative AI sure does sound like a human, right?
